title: Site-level rates and site-level coefficients estimate different quantities: a record-level benchmark for federated analysis of COVID-19 surveillance data
description: Federated analysis networks share one of two things about each site: a rate, or a coefficient from a model the site fitted locally. These are routinely treated as interchangeable summaries of the same association. They are not, and we measure how far apart they fall on a record set where both can be computed.
